package deviceapi

// Writes the vectors fount-broker's internal/mail tests read
// (internal/mail/testdata/edge-vectors.json). Copy this file into a
// fount-mail-edge checkout, or a `git archive` of one, as
// internal/deviceapi/zz_brokervectors_test.go, then run:
//
//	BROKER_VECTORS=/path/to/edge-vectors.json go test -run TestWriteBrokerVectors ./internal/deviceapi
//
// Everything below runs the edge's own code: routing.Store, store.New, the
// retention sweep, the void path and the Device API handlers.
//
// This revision writes stored-message format 2 (client IP and HELO sealed with
// the envelope) and needs an edge at 10d7677 or later. edge-vectors-v1.json was
// written by this file's previous revision (git history) from edge 861c109.

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/ecdh"
	"crypto/ed25519"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/fount-labs/fount-mail-edge/internal/routing"
	"github.com/fount-labs/fount-mail-edge/internal/store"
)

type datedBlobs struct {
	mu   sync.Mutex
	m    map[string][]byte
	mod  map[string]time.Time
	fail func(key string) bool
}

func (b *datedBlobs) Put(_ context.Context, k string, d []byte) error {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	if b.fail != nil && b.fail(k) {
		return errors.New("s3 down")
	}
	b.m[k] = append([]byte(nil), d...)
	b.mod[k] = time.Now()
	return nil
}

func (b *datedBlobs) Get(_ context.Context, k string) ([]byte, error) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	v, ok := b.m[k]
	if !ok {
		return nil, store.ErrNotFound
	}
	return append([]byte(nil), v...), nil
}

func (b *datedBlobs) List(_ context.Context, prefix string) ([]store.Object, error) {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	var out []store.Object
	for k, v := range b.m {
		if strings.HasPrefix(k, prefix) {
			out = append(out, store.Object{Key: k, Size: int64(len(v)), Modified: b.mod[k]})
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

func (b *datedBlobs) Delete(_ context.Context, k string) error {
	b.mu.Lock()
	defer b.mu.Unlock()
	delete(b.m, k)
	return nil
}

func seeded(b byte) []byte {
	s := make([]byte, 32)
	for i := range s {
		s[i] = b + byte(i)
	}
	return s
}

type vecMessage struct {
	EdgeID    string `json:"edge_id"`
	Sequence  uint64 `json:"sequence"`
	Boot      string `json:"boot"`
	Object    string `json:"object"` // base64 of the GET /mail/{id} body
	Sender    string `json:"sender"`
	Recipient string `json:"recipient"`
	ClientIP  string `json:"client_ip"`
	// ClientIPFrom is the sealed source byte: 0 none, 1 the gateway's PROXY header.
	ClientIPFrom byte   `json:"client_ip_from"`
	HELO         string `json:"helo"`
	Raw          string `json:"raw"` // base64
}

type vecRequest struct {
	Method    string `json:"method"`
	Path      string `json:"path"`
	Body      string `json:"body"`
	Timestamp int64  `json:"timestamp"`
	Nonce     string `json:"nonce"`
	Signature string `json:"signature"` // base64, accepted by the edge's guard
}

type vectors struct {
	Comment       string            `json:"comment"`
	MailboxID     string            `json:"mailbox_id"`
	SigningKey    string            `json:"signing_key"`    // ed25519 seed, base64 (RolePrivateKeys encoding)
	DecryptionKey string            `json:"decryption_key"` // x25519 private, base64
	Messages      []vecMessage      `json:"messages"`
	Withheld      []uint64          `json:"withheld"` // sequences deleted with no record
	ListResponse  string            `json:"list_response"`
	GapsResponse  string            `json:"gaps_response"`
	Boots         map[string]string `json:"boots"` // boot id -> GET /boots/{id} body
	BootKeys      map[string]string `json:"boot_keys"`
	Request       vecRequest        `json:"request"`
}

func TestWriteBrokerVectors(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("BROKER_VECTORS")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("BROKER_VECTORS not set")
	}
	ctx := context.Background()
	blobs := &datedBlobs{m: map[string][]byte{}, mod: map[string]time.Time{}}
	rblobs := newMemBlobs()
	if err := routing.Initialize(ctx, rblobs, []byte("vector-routing-key")); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	rt, err := routing.New(ctx, rblobs, []byte("vector-routing-key"), []byte("vector-mac-key"))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	signPriv := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seeded(1))
	dec, err := ecdh.X25519().NewPrivateKey(seeded(2))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	const addr = "worker@fountbox.com"
	pk := testCredentialPub(t)
	mailboxID, err := rt.Create(ctx, routing.NewMailbox{
		Address:        addr,
		LicenseHash:    []byte("vector-license"),
		DecryptionKey:  dec.PublicKey().Bytes(),
		SigningKey:     signPriv.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey),
		MailboxKey:     ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seeded(3)).Public().(ed25519.PublicKey),
		OwnerChangeKey: ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seeded(4)).Public().(ed25519.PublicKey),
		PasskeyKey:     pk,
		EntitlementExp: 0,
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}

	bootA, bootB := seeded(10)[:16], seeded(20)[:16]
	signA, signB := ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seeded(11)), ed25519.NewKeyFromSeed(seeded(21))
	stA := store.New(rt, blobs, signA, bootA, store.WithRetention(time.Hour))
	if err := stA.(store.BootStore).WriteBoot(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	v := vectors{
		Comment:       "Generated by zz_brokervectors_test.go in fount-mail-edge internal/deviceapi. Test keys only.",
		MailboxID:     hex.EncodeToString(mailboxID),
		SigningKey:    base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(seeded(1)),
		DecryptionKey: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(dec.Bytes()),
		Boots:         map[string]string{},
		BootKeys:      map[string]string{},
	}
	var ids []string
	envs := map[string]store.Envelope{}
	putMsg := func(st store.Store, env store.Envelope, raw string) string {
		env.Recipient = addr
		id, err := st.Put(ctx, env, []byte(raw))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		ids = append(ids, id)
		envs[id] = env
		return id
	}
	owner := func(ip, helo string) store.Envelope {
		env := store.Envelope{Sender: "owner@example.com", ClientIP: ip, HELO: helo}
		if ip != "" {
			env.ClientIPFrom = store.ClientIPProxy
		}
		return env
	}
	raw := func(n string) string {
		return "From: Owner <owner@example.com>\r\nTo: " + addr + "\r\nSubject: vector " + n + "\r\nMessage-ID: <" + n + "@example.com>\r\n\r\nBody " + n + "\r\n"
	}
	// seq 1: kept. seq 2: expired by the sweep. seq 3: void (S3 refused it).
	putMsg(stA, owner("192.0.2.25", "mail.example.com"), raw("1"))
	id2 := putMsg(stA, owner("192.0.2.25", "mail.example.com"), raw("2"))
	blobs.mu.Lock()
	blobs.mod["edge/mail/"+v.MailboxID+"/"+id2] = time.Now().Add(-2 * time.Hour)
	blobs.mu.Unlock()
	if res, err := stA.(store.Sweeper).Sweep(ctx, time.Now()); err != nil || res.Expired != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("sweep %+v %v", res, err)
	}
	blobs.fail = func(k string) bool { return strings.HasPrefix(k, "edge/mail/") }
	if _, err := stA.Put(ctx, store.Envelope{Sender: "owner@example.com", Recipient: addr}, []byte(raw("3"))); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("want void")
	}
	blobs.fail = nil
	// A new boot. seq 4: kept. seq 5: withheld (deleted, no record). seq 6: kept.
	stB := store.New(rt, blobs, signB, bootB, store.WithRetention(0))
	if err := stB.(store.BootStore).WriteBoot(ctx); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	putMsg(stB, owner("2001:db8::25", "mx.example.com"), raw("4"))
	id5 := putMsg(stB, owner("2001:db8::25", "mx.example.com"), raw("5"))
	if err := blobs.Delete(ctx, "edge/mail/"+v.MailboxID+"/"+id5); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	v.Withheld = []uint64{5}
	putMsg(stB, owner("", ""), raw("6"))

	api := New(Options{Store: stB, Resolver: NewKeyResolver(rt), Mutator: rt, MailDomain: "@fountbox.com"})
	n := 0
	call := func(method, path, query string) *httptest.ResponseRecorder {
		n++
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		req := signedRequest(t, signPriv, v.MailboxID, method, path, nil, time.Now(), "vector-"+string(rune('a'+n)))
		req.URL.RawQuery = query
		api.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("%s %s: %d %s", method, path, rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
		}
		return rec
	}
	v.ListResponse = call("GET", "/mail", "").Body.String()
	v.GapsResponse = call("GET", "/gaps", "").Body.String()
	for _, b := range []struct {
		id   []byte
		sign ed25519.PrivateKey
	}{{bootA, signA}, {bootB, signB}} {
		h := hex.EncodeToString(b.id)
		rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
		api.ServeHTTP(rec, httptest.NewRequest("GET", "/boots/"+h, nil))
		if rec.Code != http.StatusOK {
			t.Fatalf("boot %s: %d", h, rec.Code)
		}
		v.Boots[h] = rec.Body.String()
		v.BootKeys[h] = hex.EncodeToString(b.sign.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey))
	}
	for i, id := range ids {
		if id == id2 || id == id5 {
			continue
		}
		obj := call("GET", "/mail/"+id, "").Body.Bytes()
		boot := bootA
		if i >= 2 {
			boot = bootB
		}
		p, err := store.Parse(obj, signOf(boot, bootA, signA, signB))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		r := raw([]string{"1", "2", "4", "5", "6"}[i])
		env := envs[id]
		v.Messages = append(v.Messages, vecMessage{
			EdgeID: id, Sequence: p.Sequence, Boot: hex.EncodeToString(boot),
			Object: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(obj), Sender: env.Sender, Recipient: env.Recipient,
			ClientIP: env.ClientIP, ClientIPFrom: byte(env.ClientIPFrom), HELO: env.HELO,
			Raw: base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(r)),
		})
	}

	// A DELETE the edge's guard accepts, signed at a fixed time.
	ts := time.Now()
	req := signedRequest(t, signPriv, v.MailboxID, "DELETE", "/mail/"+v.Messages[0].EdgeID, nil, ts, "vector-delete")
	v.Request = vecRequest{Method: "DELETE", Path: "/mail/" + v.Messages[0].EdgeID, Timestamp: ts.Unix(), Nonce: "vector-delete", Signature: req.Header.Get("Fount-Signature")}
	rec := httptest.NewRecorder()
	api.ServeHTTP(rec, req)
	if rec.Code != http.StatusNoContent {
		t.Fatalf("delete: %d %s", rec.Code, rec.Body.String())
	}
	// Leave the object in the vectors: the broker's fake edge serves its own copy.

	b, err := json.MarshalIndent(v, "", "  ")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(b, '\n'), 0o644); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}

func signOf(boot, bootA []byte, a, b ed25519.PrivateKey) ed25519.PublicKey {
	if string(boot) == string(bootA) {
		return a.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)
	}
	return b.Public().(ed25519.PublicKey)
}

func testCredentialPub(t *testing.T) []byte {
	_, pk := testCredential(t)
	return pk
}
